physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the neocortex, the outer layer of the brain, the part that does the thinking nobody asked it to do. It is where the loops live. The mind running its preferred route again, then again, until the route is the only one that feels like thinking at all. It is fitting that the code of addiction sits here, in the same tissue that does the planning and the noticing and the speaking. The loop is not a flaw on top of a sound machine. It is the machine running a familiar program.

The shadow has a bodily floor in this tissue. When the addiction is on, the cortex is loud. Thought after thought, none of them rested in, all of them propelling the next. The body feels it as a low buzz behind the eyes, a head that will not put itself down, a kind of friction that finds the same grooves and rides them. Sleep does not quite unhook it. Even the silence between sentences feels like something to be filled.

The climb out is also in this tissue, and it is felt as a settling. The buzz drops a level. A thought arrives and is allowed to finish, and then nothing arrives for a moment, and the moment does not need to be patched. The cortex learns it can be quiet without being absent. That is the gift catching, lower down than insight. The same surface that ran the loop is the surface that can hold the pause.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the cortex, this code answers to Leucine. Leucine is one of the small set of amino acids the body cannot make for itself, and it has to be taken in from outside, carried across the line of the mouth before it can do any of its work. Once inside, it is one of the body's loudest signals for building, the molecule that tells the cells it is time to grow, to rebuild, to put new tissue where the old has been spent.

There is a teaching in that, and it sits cleanly under the card. The code of return runs on a chemistry that itself has to be received, and the chemistry's main job is the rebuilding that happens after something has been used up. The loop wears the cortex down. Leucine is what is asked for when the rebuilding begins. The body is already doing, at the level of its smallest letters, the very thing the card is asking of the mind: take in what you cannot make, and let it be put to use.
